data.body: Patch set 1 of Gerrit 3180 got LLM-Review +1 and Verified -1: all 7 bounded-mutation-gate shards failed in 'mutmut run' after the clean run passed. Root cause, reproduced locally: mutmut runs pytest from a mutants/ copy holding src/rebar, tests/, pyproject.toml and .github/ (scripts/mutation_gate.py render_mutmut_config plus mutmut 3.7 defaults) but not scripts/, so the new conftest loader raised FileNotFoundError on scripts/gen_api_surface.py and pytest exited 3 (simulated copy: HEAD rc=3, HEAD^ rc=0). Fix in patch set 2: skip the check when the gate script is absent (no surface gate to mislead there), and raise UsageError instead of silently passing when a present script cannot be loaded (LLM-Review advisory). New regression test copies tests/*.py, pyproject.toml and .github/git-version-floor.txt into tmp and asserts a nested pytest starts (red before, green after). Also added tests for 3 test-coverage advisories (declared None path, None-safe assertion, stale install + real drift still advises --update). 28/28 in the file; targeted 90 files 1103 passed, 2 skipped; lint and typecheck pass.
